yorum: For the same price, you could stay in a five-star hotel in Istanbul, Madrid, or Rome. But in Bodrum, it's nothing special because hotels here are so expensive. This hotel is comparable to a two-star hotel or a youth hostel in China. Although relatively new, the facilities are extremely basic. The location isn't very convenient either; without a car, it's practically impossible to get around. Fortunately, the manager was very helpful!

There was no reception to greet us when we checked in; we contacted them by phone, so we couldn't use the hotel's kitchen for tea, coffee, hot water, etc. This was the only thing that disappointed us a little. Otherwise, our room was clean, the view was very beautiful, and the location was good.
It's a simple, clean, pleasant, and fairly new hotel. It's perfect for short stays. The bed was comfortable, with a soft mattress, which suited me perfectly.
